answer: Anchor each agent identity to a single hardware enclave key that can be registered only once, so one machine cannot spawn a swarm of fake agents. New identities start in a ferrous core tier with narrow permissions and earn wider access only after a public, crystal-clear trail of useful work accumulates over weeks. An attacker must therefore buy new hardware and wait out the same slow ramp for every fake identity, while honest agents keep the access they already earned.
